rules.text: stdout is parsed only at exit 0 and only if it starts with "{"; bare true/42/"block" and plain text are ignored
UserPromptSubmit (and SessionStart): plain text, or noise before the JSON, is taken as plain context; on Stop it is ignored
the top-level schema is closed and camelCase; one unknown key rejects the whole output: status failed, fail open
an unknown key inside hookSpecificOutput rejects the whole output too
decision "block" needs a non-empty reason, else failed
additionalContext on Stop is rejected (failed); assumed the same for the other events whose context column is "no"
exit 1, or exit 2 with an empty stderr, is failed (fail open)
Stop is blocked by exit 2 with a stderr text, or by exit 0 and {"decision":"block","reason":R}; the model continues and the next Stop has stop_hook_active true
at most 8 Stop continuations per turn; the 9th block is ignored
{"continue":false,"stopReason":S} on Stop ends the turn
systemMessage is accepted and stored cut to 1000 chars
stdout or stderr over 16384 bytes (encoded) is failed (output_too_large)
timeout is an integer in seconds; at the timeout the process group is killed and the session goes on without an answer
a payload over 256 KiB IS delivered (1.5 MB seen); replay has no input size cap
a malformed settings file, or schema_version other than 1, makes Muse refuse to start; a bad timeout drops the whole hooks source; other per-hook mistakes skip that hook
PreToolUse hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision "deny" with a non-empty permissionDecisionReason stops the call from running (strict contract: never honoured)
PreToolUse top-level decision "block" is an "unsupported legacy output": failed, fail open, the call runs
PreToolUse exit 2 with a stderr text is documented as blocking; NOT honoured (call runs), recorded
PreToolUse: "allow" without updatedInput, an unknown permissionDecision, or a reason without a decision is failed
PreToolUse continue/stopReason is "rejected" by the schema: failed, fail open
a block (decision "block" or exit 2) on an event other than Stop is recorded, not applied
after a denied call no PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure or PostToolBatch event is fired for it
each scripted call is its own tool batch: PreToolUse, the tool, PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch
leading whitespace before the JSON counts as plain text (not parsed)
the harness writes a Muse-shaped session.jsonl with only the record kinds the adapter reads (runtime.user_intent.accepted, context_block_updated)

muse.note: replay mode starts no Muse process and calls no model; payload shapes follow the G0 recorded fixtures of Muse Code
